# todo: invalidate the reconciler cache per file

## Context

The scanner drops its whole reconciler cache whenever any input changes, so
editing one file costs a full rescan of the tree. On a large project that is
the difference between a rescan a person waits for and one they do not notice.

## Done when

- A single changed file invalidates only the cache entries that file feeds.
- An unchanged file is never re-reconciled because a sibling changed.
- The scanner's own tests cover a one-file edit and assert the untouched
  entries survived.
